answer: Reaching eligibility takes 81 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone forfeits for every seat it wants. The voyage register is checked at draw time, beacon lists the eligible set, and sable seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 81 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Honest users pay that once, farms 25 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
